note: Financial obligation facts, including opaque PSP references, are retained for refund recovery/reconciliation and accounting. Personal/free-text reason and receipt copies are scrubbed without changing financial authority.

structures.ReturnReceipt: Immutable response snapshot that can contain personal reason/contact data; erased as a whole while authoritative financial columns remain intact.
structures.Sha256Digest: Opaque 32-byte request/receive/refund-integrity digest; never raw reason, receipt, token or contact data.

subject.null_subject_policy: Guest return inherits unverified order contact; arbitrary reason/provider/receipt text does not prove registered customer ownership.
